description: Send a 6-digit SMS code to a phone number, to verify the caller owns it before showing ride history or allowing a cancellation. Required before calling list_my_rides, get_ride_status, cancel_ride, or redeem_gift.

phone.description: Any common format is fine (e.g. "305-555-0100"); non-digit characters other than a leading + are stripped server-side.

name: request_verification_code
title: Request a phone verification code
